S.FORM: s'urux Kyoyibu qani, mtama mmrhu ciyal qa mwah klahang bawiq tqbaqan, gaga na Bunka ki SeziKyoyic, aring kya lga Kyoyibu san maha sinbalay lalu nya. In'ringan pinc'urx pplahang qa CwangFaminko, Pcpung tkbaqan-bu ga wayal inyugan lalu nya, snyan naha Kyoyibu Mubuy ktalan binah Canpyuta 教育部
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]ʔurux kjojiβu qani mtama mmrħu [ʦ|ʨ]ijal qa mwaħ klaħaŋ βawiq tqβaqan ɣaɣa na βunka ki [s|ɕ]ezikjoji[ʦ|ʨ] ariŋ kja lɣa kjojiβu [s|ɕ]an maħa [s|ɕ]inβalaj lalu nja inʔriŋan pin[ʦ|ʨ]ʔurx pplaħaŋ qa [ʦ|ʨ]waŋ*aminko p[ʦ|ʨ]puŋ tkβaqanβu ɣa wajal injuɣan lalu nja [s|ɕ]njan naħa kjojiβu muβuj ktalan βinaħ [ʦ|ʨ]anpjuta ***
